message.content: As of now—late May 2026—the Vice‑President of the United States is **Kamala D. Harris**. She serves under President Joe Biden, having taken office on January 20, 2021. If you’re looking at a very recent event (e.g., an inauguration, resignation, or other political shift) that might have changed this status after my last update, I recommend checking a reliable news source or the official White House website for confirmation.
